notes.title: Black Friday in League of Masters and More!
notes.content:
Hi! In honor of Black Freya Day (a holiday we just made up) and Black Friday, here’s what we’ve added:

- New offers are now available in the Bank.
- Players can bless themselves and double their rating change in the battle start window.
- Comics have been translated into new languages.
- Subscription bonuses now apply to Arena battles.
- The tutorial has been expanded.
- Other technical updates and bug fixes.

And the biggest news—Subscriptions are now in effect for Arena drops!

The Sphere of Prosperity and the Horn of Abundance can now be earned in PvP if you have King Arthur's Royal Privileges ability.

You can read more details on our social media, but for now, jump into the game—there’s plenty more exciting stuff ahead!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924820/a95394382e7bcb456014af1922a923b7d06236d7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Limited Launch Gift!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce an exclusive offer for our early supporters. The first 10,000 players who launch the game will receive a [b]Limited Launch Gift[/b] — a massive package filled with in-game currency and valuable items to kickstart your journey!

What is inside? Take a look:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924820/c5713bffb8eb110908d57908646fcfaadd246c94.png[/img]

This is our way of saying thank you for being among the first to dive into the adventure. Don’t miss out—be among the first to experience everything our game has to offer and claim your Limited Launch Gift!

How to Claim:

1. Launch the game within the first 10.000 people.
2. The gift will automatically be added to your inventory.

Join the adventure now, add us to your wishlist, and get a head start with these amazing rewards.
[b]We can’t wait to see you in League of Masters![/b]

notes.title: League Of Masters | Dev Diary #1
notes.content:
Hello to all the masters out there! We're kicking off a series of stories about our game features, gameplay mechanics, and our social media presence to help build a community around our game!

So let's get started! What is [b]League Of Masters[/b]? It's a multiplayer auto-chess strategy game set in a vibrant fantasy world.

[b]League of Masters[/b] takes a unique approach to the autobattler genre. Instead of solely focusing on unit compositions, players can harness the power of 12 unique commanders. Each commander possesses extraordinary abilities that can significantly sway the tide of battle. Form an unstoppable army from over 50 diverse fighters, each with distinct classes and synergies that can be exploited in both PvE and PvP battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924820/5b157662e9b0983c3a272575078e7286603fbdf2.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Features[/b][/h1][list]
[*] RPG-style player progression
[*] Battles based on popular autochess mechanics
[*] Emphasis on strengthening commanders rather than units
[*] PvP Ranking System
[*] Numerous gaming features for socializing
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Battle Mechanics[/b][/h1][list]
[*] 12 unique commanders with their own set of abilities
[*] Dynamic battles lasting 15-20 minutes
[*] Players create a squad and do not participate directly in battles during rounds
[*] Identical fighters can be combined to enhance their strength
[*] Sets of related fighters offer additional bonuses
[*] The in-battle fighter shop is competitive
[/list]

Feel free to ask questions, add League of Masters to your wishlist, and stay tuned for updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2808830/League_of_Masters_Auto_Chess
[hr][/hr]
For more on League of Masters, follow the game on social media on the following channels:

► Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/LOM_AutoChess

► Find us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/leagueofmastersautochess

► Join other fans on Discord: https://discord.gg/leagueofmasters
